description: A GuardDuty-flagged compromised IAM credential, followed by that same actor attaching an admin policy -- cross-source: GuardDuty finding + CloudTrail activity, correlated by actor.user_name.
playbook: GuardDuty already flagged this credential as compromised (Tor exit node, known-malicious IP, or similar), and the same identity then granted itself admin -- a live account takeover in progress, not a false positive worth waiting on. Disable the user immediately, rotate/delete the access key GuardDuty flagged, and review every action taken by this identity since the GuardDuty finding.
